import sys
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    M = int(next(it))
    
    # Build graph: nodes 0..N-1 for participants, nodes N..N+M-1 for languages
    total_nodes = N + M
    graph = [[] for _ in range(total_nodes)]
    
    for participant in range(N):
        k = int(next(it))
        for _ in range(k):
            lang = int(next(it)) - 1  # zero-indexed language
            lang_node = N + lang
            graph[participant].append(lang_node)
            graph[lang_node].append(participant)
    
    # BFS from participant 0
    visited = [False] * total_nodes
    q = deque()
    visited[0] = True
    q.append(0)
    
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in graph[u]:
            if not visited[v]:
                visited[v] = True
                q.append(v)
    
    # Check if all participants are reachable
    for p in range(N):
        if not visited[p]:
            print("NO")
            return
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
